question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Uncle Joe is ___________________(reputable) for spending 10 years of his youth in prison due to armed robbery.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"reputable"** means having a good reputation; respected and trusted by most people. (प्रतिष्ठित)

 
 
• **Example:** She is a **reputable** scientist known for her groundbreaking research.
 
 
 
• **"Notorious"** refers to being famous or well-known for some bad quality or deed. (कुख्यात)
 
 
• **Example:** The area is **notorious **for its high crime rate.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'reputable'** is **'notorious'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mournful** (शोकाकुल): Feeling or expressing sorrow or grief.

 
 
• **Example:** The **mournful **melody of the violin brought tears to everyone's eyes.
 
 
 
• **Anxious** (चिंतित): Experiencing worry, unease, or nervousness.
 
 
• **Example:** She was **anxious** about the upcoming exam.
 
 
 
• **Well-known** (प्रसिद्ध): Known by many people or recognized by many.
 
 
• **Example:** He is** well-known **for his philanthropic activities.
